headline: Soybeans Fall 3% on Eased Iran Tensions

article.summary: Chicago soybean futures fell the most in more than two months as a pause in fighting between the US and Iran eased fears of further escalation, sending crude tumbling. Soybean oil is a key biofuel feedstock, and lower crude prices diminish its appeal.
